title: syzygium heyneanum
intro: Syzygium heyneanum, commonly known as the Malabar plum or Java plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Syzygium heyneanum include its use in treating fever, cough, and diarrhea, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be exerted through its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
